topics.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang resigns amid affair scandal
topics.why: The board ousting the founder-CEO of the world's most valuable chipmaker, over an affair involving an alleged Chinese spy, is a reminder that even AI's most dominant leaders aren't untouchable.

topics.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
topics.why: A new frontier model plus a cheaper everyday model at the same API price means better AI tools for anyone already building on ChatGPT or the API, with no price hike.

topics.title: OpenAI raises $15B at a $1.25T valuation
topics.why: That's only half the $30B OpenAI was reportedly seeking and below the $1.4T it pitched investors — a sign even AI's biggest name is facing pickier money.
